name: intl
summary: Dart internationalization package for localized messages, date and number formatting/parsing, bidirectional text, and related locale-aware functionality.
advantages: Provides locale-aware date, number, currency, and message formatting
Published by dart.dev and used by Flutter localization workflows
tradeoffs: It is an internationalization utility package rather than a complete Flutter localization workflow
Applications still need to choose how localized resources are stored and generated
recommendedFor: Projects that need locale-aware date, number, or currency formatting
Localization workflows that use Flutter gen_l10n or other message-generation systems

verification.reason: Current pub.dev metadata and Flutter internationalization documentation are sufficient.
